title: Quarterly Services Survey
summary: U.S. selected services total revenue for the second quarter of 2025, adjusted for seasonal variation but not for price changes, was $5,965.2 billion, an increase of 2.2 percent (+/- 0.4 percent) from the first quarter of 2025 and up 6.4 percent (+/- 0.4 percent) from the second quarter of 2024. The first quarter of 2025 to second quarter of 2025 percent change was not revised from the advance estimate.2nd Qtr 2025: +2.2 % Change1st Qtr 2025 (r): +1.2 % Change
